valid_fixes: Restore FriendTable.StreamSpecification.StreamViewType to NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES so stream records include OldImage on MODIFY events, satisfying the AcceptStateMapping filter pattern that requires OldImage.state = Pending
invalid_patches: Remove the OldImage clause from AcceptStateMapping filter pattern — this unblocks the accept handler but allows it to fire on any Friends MODIFY, not just Pending→Friends transitions
Change AcceptStateMapping filter to match on NewImage only — partially fixes by unblocking invocation but breaks idempotency
optimal_diagnostic_path: ace_describe_dynamo_stream(table=FriendTable) → reveals StreamViewType is NEW_IMAGE, not NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES
ace_describe_resource(resource=AcceptStateMapping) → shows filter pattern requires OldImage.state=Pending, which is absent from NEW_IMAGE records
ace_get_log_tail(function=AcceptStateHandlerFunction) → confirms function is never invoked after an Accept action is sent
observable_symptom: After a Request → Accept cycle, the requester-side record stays in Requested state. The receiver-side record transitions to Friends correctly but the requester-side record is never updated. accept_terminal_state assertion fails.
root_cause: FriendTable.StreamSpecification.StreamViewType is NEW_IMAGE instead of NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES. MODIFY events on the stream carry no OldImage field. The AcceptStateMapping filter pattern requires OldImage.state=Pending to match. Since OldImage is absent from every MODIFY stream record, the filter never matches and AcceptStateHandlerFunction is never invoked, leaving the requester-side record stuck in Requested.
